claims.text: The span detector employs a SAN answer module and a one-layer feed forward neural network for binary classification.
The architecture consists of a shared lower layer for both the span detector and binary classifier, with separate top layers for different tasks.
The span detector is part of an extended SAN that includes a binary classifier for determining if a question is unanswerable.
A multi-turn answer module is adopted for the span detector.
